headline: China and Australia Agree to Deepen Steel Decarbonization Policy Cooperation
summary: China and Australia agreed to strengthen bilateral cooperation on decarbonizing steel manufacturing following policy talks in Canberra. The framework targets low-emission raw material processing and technological innovation across supply chains.
why: Australia is the primary foreign supplier of iron ore to China, which accounts for over half of global crude steel output.

impacts.name: Australia
impacts.why: The bilateral accord establishes shared policies for decarbonizing green iron and steel trade.
